item.title: Mitsubishi Minica 70 (1969)
item.description:
Publication: Motor Fan
Format: Road Test
Date: October 1969
Author (Roundtable): Yukichi Mochida, Hiroshi Hoshijima, Isao Imai, Akio Miyamoto, Osamu Wake, Kenji Higuchi, Atsushi Watari, Katsuhiko Makino, Hajime Hattori, Taizo Tateishi, Kasuo Kumabe, Kunitaka Furutani, Kenzaburo Ishikawa, Masahide Sano, Toshihide Hirata, Minoru Onda, Jiro Takahashi, Motor Fan Editorial Staff (uncredited)

Aiming for a Small Passenger Car

Magazine: The Mitsubishi Minica 70 has been introduced with completely new styling for the first time in seven years. Mr. Mochida, perhaps you could begin by telling us about its key features.
